title: the fourth man in the fire

verses.text: “Look!” he exclaimed. “I see four men, unbound and unharmed, walking around in the fire—and the fourth looks like a son of the gods! ”

caption:
Some fires do not get put out. You get walked through them.

The king looked into the furnace expecting three men and counted four. The flames were still burning, and someone was walking in them alongside the ones who would not bow. What you are standing in today may not lift by morning, but you are not in it alone.

Daniel 3:25 (BSB)
